---
title: "Pna scRNA-seq UMAP"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(Seurat)
```

## Load data

```{r load}
# Load cell-type annotations
meta <- read.delim(
  "Pna.cell_to_cts.csv.gz",
  row.names = 1
)

# Load gene expression count matrix
counts <- ReadMtx(
  mtx = "Pna.counts.mtx.gz",
  cells = "Pna.cell_to_cts.csv.gz",
  cell.column = 1,
  skip.cell = 1,
  features = "Pna.genes.txt.gz",
  feature.column = 1
)

# Align metadata with cell barcodes
stopifnot(all(colnames(counts) %in% rownames(meta)))
meta <- meta[colnames(counts), , drop = FALSE]
```

## Create Seurat object

```{r seurat}
pna <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = counts,
  meta.data = meta,
  project = "Pna",
  min.cells = 5
)

# Inspect cell-type distribution
table(pna$cell_type)
```

## Normalization, PCA, clustering, UMAP

```{r umap}
# Normalize data (LogNormalize, scale factor 10,000) and identify variable features
pna <- NormalizeData(pna, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
pna <- FindVariableFeatures(pna)

# Scale data and perform PCA
pna <- ScaleData(pna)
pna <- RunPCA(pna, npcs = 50)

# Construct shared nearest-neighbor graph using the first 40 PCs and cluster
pna <- FindNeighbors(pna, dims = 1:40)
pna <- FindClusters(pna, resolution = 0.8)

# Compute UMAP
pna <- RunUMAP(pna, dims = 1:40, n.neighbors = 30, min.dist = 0.3)

# Rotate UMAP 90 degrees clockwise: (x, y) -> (y, -x)
umap_emb <- Embeddings(pna, "umap")
pna[["umap"]]@cell.embeddings <- cbind(
  umap_1 = umap_emb[, 2],
  umap_2 = -umap_emb[, 1]
)

# Number of clusters
length(levels(pna$seurat_clusters))
```

## Visualize UMAP by cluster

```{r dimplot_cluster, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}
DimPlot(
  pna,
  reduction = "umap",
  pt.size = 0.5,
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  label = TRUE
)
```

## Visualize UMAP by annotated cell type

```{r dimplot, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}
DimPlot(
  pna,
  reduction = "umap",
  pt.size = 0.5,
  group.by = "cell_type",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE
)
```

## Save Seurat object

```{r save}
saveRDS(pna, "Pna_UMAP.rds")
```
